children: State-run power utility NTPC Limited and EDF Power Solutions India Private Limited, a wholly owned arm of French power company EDF, have entered into a 50:50 joint venture agreement to develop and operate low-carbon energy infrastructure jointly.

According to a release, the partnership will focus on the development, ownership and operation of pumped storage projects, hydroelectric installations, other renewable energy facilities and electricity distribution operations. The newly created entity will undertake power projects in India as well as neighbouring countries.

The agreement was formally signed on September 25 in the presence of Gurdeep Singh, Chairman and Managing Director of NTPC Limited, and Bernard Fontana, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer of EDF SA, France.

Under the terms of the agreement, the partnership aims to establish a joint industrial enterprise focused on green transition assets. The release said both companies remain committed to building a responsible and innovative industrial company.

“Through this strategic partnership, NTPC and EDF Power Solutions are committed to establish a responsible and innovative industrial company to develop, build and operate low carbon powerplants as well as flexibility solutions and transmission assets,” the release said.

The strategic partnership will align its project pipeline with India's long-term energy transition targets, including the government's goal of reaching 100 gigawatts of installed pumped storage capacity by 2036.

The companies said they intend to combine their technical and operational resources, stating that the entities will work "to provide tailormade offers, drive the decarbonization and global performance of electrical systems."

The release said both power operators expect their combined resources to support regular additions to renewable capacity, adding that both firms are prepared "to contribute significantly to India's renewable energy market, driving innovation and fostering environmental stewardship."

title: NTPC, France’s EDF Power Solutions form 50:50 JV to build low-carbon energy projects
